title: Centralized Governance for Regional Data Residency
business: Global enterprises with strict regulatory requirements for data sovereignty.
problem: Individual project owners frequently deploy resources in unauthorized regions, leading to non-compliance with regional data residency laws and potential legal exposure.
solution: The organization uses Organization Policy to enforce centralized constraints, specifically the 'Resource Location Restriction' constraint, which prevents the creation of resources in non-compliant regions across the entire hierarchy.
steps: Identify the specific folders or organization node requiring the restriction.
Define the list of allowed regions in the policy constraint.
Apply the constraint at the organization level to ensure inheritance.
Verify that project owners are blocked from creating resources in restricted regions.
Audit policy compliance using the Resource Manager and Policy Intelligence tools.
outcome: Consistent, automated enforcement of regional boundaries that eliminates manual oversight and ensures continuous regulatory compliance.
limitation: Strict policies can break automated CI/CD pipelines that rely on specific regions; check compliance by reviewing the effective policy hierarchy in the Google Cloud Console.
